definitions.explanation: A dictionary that defines Japanese words in Japanese, used by native speakers and advanced learners. Distinct from bilingual dictionaries such as {和英辞典|わえいじてん} (Japanese-English dictionary).

examples.japanese: {国語辞典|こくごじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look it up in a Japanese dictionary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{国語辞典|こくごじてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new Japanese dictionary.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{国語辞典|こくごじてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧みよう。
examples.english: I don't know what this word means, so let me look it up in a Japanese dictionary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{国語辞典|こくごじてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many Japanese dictionaries that even elementary school students can use are published.

notes:
A dictionary that explains Japanese words in Japanese, comparable to monolingual English dictionaries like Merriam-Webster or the Oxford English Dictionary. These are the standard reference works used in Japanese schools and homes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国語辞典|こくごじてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to consult a Japanese dictionary
- {国語辞典|こくごじてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to look up in a Japanese dictionary
- {国語辞典|こくごじてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧: to be listed in a Japanese dictionary
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{国語辞典|こくごじてん}: an electronic Japanese dictionary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和英辞典|わえいじてん}→和英辞典：24664_waeijiten⟧: Japanese-English dictionary — translates Japanese words into English
- ⟦{英和辞典|えいわじてん}→英和辞典：23359_eiwajiten⟧: English-Japanese dictionary — translates English words into Japanese
- {漢和辞典|かんわじてん}: kanji dictionary — focused on the meanings and readings of individual kanji
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: dictionary (general term) — covers any type of dictionary

CULTURAL NOTE:
Well-known Japanese dictionaries include {広辞苑|こうじえん}, {大辞林|だいじりん}, and {新明解国語辞典|しんめいかいこくごじてん}. Each has its own editorial character — {新明解|しんめいかい} is famous for its unusually opinionated definitions.
